High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench

Applicant :- Radha

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P Thru. Prin. Secy. Deptt. Lko
Counsel for Applicant :- Faizal Hashmi,K.K. Singh
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned AGA and perused the record.

The FIR in question was lodged alleging that the daughter of the informant was married around eight months ago to the son of the applicant and she was being harassed on account of non-payment of dowry.
It was also alleged that on 16.02.2023, the entire family members with the use of rope caused the death of the victim.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 1 3. Learned counsel for the applicant argues that the post-mortem report, reveals that the cause of death was ante-mortem hanging.
No specific injury to demonstrate any physical violence was revealed on the body.
It is argued that the death occurred around seven days after the alleged commission of offence.
It is also on record that it is husband, son of the informant, who had taken the victim to the hospital where her treatment continued.
There is no statement on record of the victim during the entire tenure of the treatment as she died on 23.02.2023.
The applicant is a lady and is in custody since 27.03.2023.
4. Learned AGA opposes the bail application.

5. Considering the fact that prima-facie, the death is on account of ante-mortem hanging, there is no statement of the victim during the entire tenure of her treatment coupled with the fact that the applicant is a lady, she has no criminal antecedent and is also entitled to the benefit of proviso to Section 437 Cr.P.C., the applicant is entitled to be enlarged on bail.
In view thereof, the application is allowed.

6. Let the applicant Radha be released on bail in FIR No.61 of 2023, under Section 498A, 304B IPC & Section 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, P.S. Kotwali Nagar, District Balrampur on her furnishing a personal bond with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which she is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
Order Date :- 18.7.2023 nishant  Radha vs State Of U.P Thru. Prin. Secy. Deptt. Lko on 18 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/195896516/
